Charter Flight

In a pandemic Covid-19 like now, where all flights cannot operate regularly to and from Saudi Arabia, Aviaventura is active in repatriating Indonesian citizens in there to return here.

In cooperation with Garuda Indonesia on the Jeddah and Riyadh routes, Aviaventura has chartered Flight B 777-300 with 385 Economy Class and 26 Business Class Capacities. This repatriation flight has successfully done which 2 flights were fully occupied.

Be Our Partner

Since 2016, AVIAVENTURA has proudly served as a trusted GSA in Indonesia, managing operations for over eight airlines. Our commitment to personalized service and market expertise ensures that partnering with us means your airline will achieve sustained success in the Indonesian market.
